r.ScreenPercentage.quality_impact: Renders at lower internal resolution, so the image looks softer; 50 is very blurry

r.Shadow.CSM.MaxCascades.quality_impact: Less shadow detail on distant objects

r.PostProcessAAQuality.quality_impact: More jagged or shimmering edges; 0 is almost no anti-aliasing

r.VolumetricFog.quality_impact: Removes light shafts and fog volumes

r.MotionBlurQuality.quality_impact: Low (cosmetic): less or no motion blur; many players turn it off anyway

r.LensFlareQuality.quality_impact: Low (cosmetic): removes lens flares around bright lights

r.SceneColorFringeQuality.quality_impact: Low (cosmetic): removes chromatic aberration (color fringing at screen edges)

r.BloomQuality.quality_impact: Low: glow around bright areas is less smooth; 0 removes bloom

r.DepthOfFieldQuality.quality_impact: Low: background/foreground blur is rougher; 0 removes it

r.SSR.Quality.quality_impact: Medium: screen-space reflections get noisier; 0 turns them off

r.VolumetricFog.GridPixelSize.quality_impact: Low: coarser fog and light shafts (fog stays on)

r.ShadowQuality.quality_impact: Medium to severe: shadows get softer and less precise; 0 turns dynamic shadows off

r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.DownsampleFact.quality_impact: Medium: Lumen indirect lighting gets blotchier, especially in small details

r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge.quality_impact: Low to medium: Nanite meshes use fewer triangles, fine detail softens

r.SkeletalMeshLODBias.quality_impact: Low: characters use lower levels of detail

r.ViewDistanceScale.quality_impact: Low to severe (CPU lever): distant objects stop drawing sooner; at 0.2 much of the scene pops in close to the camera

foliage.DensityScale.quality_impact: Low at 0.75 up to severe at 0 (CPU lever): sparser grass and plants; 0 removes them

foliage.LODDistanceScale.quality_impact: Low (CPU lever): plants switch to simpler models closer to the camera

r.StaticMeshLODDistanceScale.quality_impact: Low (CPU lever): non-Nanite meshes switch to simpler models sooner (higher = simpler sooner)

r.Shadow.DistanceScale.quality_impact: Medium (CPU and GPU lever): shadows stop being drawn closer to the camera, so fewer objects are processed for shadows; distant objects lose their shadows

r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing.quality_impact: Medium (CPU and GPU lever): Lumen switches from hardware ray tracing to cheaper software tracing; lighting and reflections get slightly less accurate

r.Shadow.Virtual.Enable.quality_impact: Medium (GPU lever): swaps Virtual Shadow Maps for older cascaded shadows; distant shadows get softer. The r.Shadow.MaxResolution and CSM settings only take effect when this is 0

r.Lumen.Reflections.Allow.quality_impact: Medium (GPU lever): turns off Lumen reflections; shiny surfaces fall back to simpler reflections

r.Lumen.DiffuseIndirect.Allow.quality_impact: Severe (GPU lever): turns off Lumen global illumination; bounced light disappears and shaded areas get flat and dark

r.VolumetricCloud.quality_impact: Medium (GPU lever): removes volumetric clouds from the sky

r.DistanceFieldShadowing.quality_impact: Medium (GPU lever): removes distance field shadows (soft shadows from distant objects)
